supportedChannels.description: Supported channels for the contact list

activationTimeLagMinutes.description: Contact list activation time lag in minutes (0 = immediate activation, 180 = 3 hours delay). Required if activationDateTime is not provided.

activationDateTime.description: Contact list activation DateTimeStamp (format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM). Required if activationTimeLagMinutes is not provided.
